import cadquery as cq
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .polygon(6, 15.012)
    .extrude(15.0)
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .hole(8.0)
)
result = result.rotate((0, 0, 0), (1, 1, 0), 75)
show_object(result)
